instructions: This is a template. Copy it to benchmark/reviews/<your-name>.json and fill in the ratings.
Rate each answer 1-5 on the three criteria. Use whole numbers only.
The answer labels (X and Y) are assigned per brief by a hash of the protocol file, so they are stable and reproducible. They do not correspond to 'first' and 'second'.
If you cannot judge an answer, use null and give a reason. Do not guess.
Do not open benchmark/results.json until you have submitted your ratings.

criteria.relevance: How well does this set of tracks fit the scene as described?
criteria.variety: How varied is this set, rather than several versions of the same idea?
criteria.wouldUse: If you were the music supervisor, how likely would you be to put this in front of a director?

reviewer: REPLACE WITH A NAME OR HANDLE
